name: OpenClipper
description: Turn a long video into short vertical clips. Upload a podcast, tutorial or talk (hours long, up to 30 GB), and OpenClipper finds the strongest moments, cuts them on clean sentence boundaries, lays each one out for 9:16 and burns in captions. Every clip is yours to trim, drop or re-render.

deploy.title: Deploy your OpenClipper
deploy.subtitle: Long videos in, captioned vertical clips out.

prompts.label: What are your long videos?
prompts.placeholder: e.g. 2-hour synth plugin walkthroughs, weekly podcast episodes
